sections.Profile:
Released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1966, Dancing Lady is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ed Krynski, with artwork by Art Stenholm. A ballerina spins in a backbox light-box animation above a playfield built around a center carousel roto-target, and about 2,675 units were made.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Ballet, Backbox Gimmick, Dancing, Nightlife, Original Theme
